$comment: The old→new utility table, applied mechanically by scripts/apply-remap.mjs.
Produced and reviewed as a table BEFORE being applied, because 151 distinct
utilities across 610 occurrences is too many judgement calls to hand to per-file
agents — they would each decide differently and the inconsistency would be
Alpha modifiers are preserved automatically: a rule for `bg-primary-900` also
rewrites `bg-primary-900/50`. Only list a suffixed form when it maps somewhere
DIFFERENT from its base (e.g. a wash).
`ambiguous` entries are deliberately NOT rewritten. They are the sites where the
old vocabulary was doing more than one job, so the right target depends on what
the element is for. apply-remap.mjs reports them for a human/agent pass.

surfaces.$why: The four FACE surfaces, by role. The old indigo ramp and the three brand-ink tones were both approximating the same ladder.

borders.$why: surfaceHighlight is the card-border idiom (hairline). primary-600/500 were the stronger boundary, which is what `edge` is for. secondary-500 borders were the same card idiom wearing the purple.

inks.$why: Three indigo rungs (300/400/500) collapse to one muted ink — a documented rung loss, because FACE has two text tones rather than three. brand-paper was doing double duty as ink AND as a light ground; as text it is textPrimary.

accents.$why: The fill/ink split is the biggest correctness win here: 12 text-brand-green sites were a FILL carrying text. FACE is explicit that oliveInk is the only olive that may.

washes.$why: FACE's chipWashAlpha is 0.15 and it is a CEILING set by olive (4.64 at .15, 4.44 at .18). The ported code used 5/10/15/20 ad hoc. Anything at or below the ceiling becomes the named wash so the number lives in one place.

shadows.$why: FACE: 'Elevation 0 everywhere. Depth is an opaque warm surface plus a hairline, not blur.' origin/main killed the same thing independently ('a glow means nothing on paper and reads as a games console'). These are DELETED, not remapped — the empty string removes the class.

radii.$why: FACE's scale. `rounded-card` needs no rewrite — the CLASS name is unchanged and its VALUE moves 2rem/32px -> 18px in the preset, so existing call sites pick it up for free. Stock Tailwind radii are left alone: rounded-lg (8px) on a small element is fine and remapping it to the 12px chip would change pixels for no reason.

ambiguous.$why: NOT rewritten. Each of these was doing more than one job in the old vocabulary, so the target depends on what the element is. apply-remap.mjs lists every occurrence with its file and line for a judgement pass.
ambiguous.text-secondary-500: muted body text -> text-secondary; an emphatic accent -> text-ink-accent. 35 sites.
ambiguous.text-secondary-500/70: same, with the alpha folded into text-secondary (which carries its own).
ambiguous.text-brand-tan: FACE has no tan ink. Decorative -> text-secondary; if it was marking a value, -> text-ink-accent.
ambiguous.text-brand-green/30: a washed olive TEXT — the defect this migration exists to remove. Needs a real decision: ink at full strength, or a wash background with ink-success on it.
ambiguous.text-brand-paper/50: -> text-secondary (which already carries the correct per-ramp alpha). Do not stack another modifier.
ambiguous.bg-secondary-500: a solid purple fill: an accent surface -> bg-fill-accent; a selected state -> bg-fill-accent-wash + border-fill-accent.
ambiguous.bg-primary-500: an indigo fill with no FACE counterpart. Usually a mark background -> bg-fill-accent-wash.
ambiguous.ring-secondary-500: focus ring -> ring-fill-accent, BUT it measures 3.02:1 over surface-well on the sheet ground (zero headroom), so pair with a 1px offset.
ambiguous.from-secondary-500: gradient start. Icon tiles and headline sweeps -> from-fill-accent to-accent-lift.
ambiguous.via-secondary-500/10: gradient midpoint; usually deletable once the sweep is two-stop.
ambiguous.from-secondary-500/5: washed gradient start -> from-fill-accent-wash (now a real gradient stop, carrying the measured 0.15) or delete if the sweep is two-stop.
ambiguous.to-primary-400: an indigo gradient stop with no counterpart; usually -> to-surface-raised.
ambiguous.border-secondary-500/30: the card-border idiom at rest -> border-hairline. Kept ambiguous because a few sites used it as a SELECTED state, which is border-fill-accent.
ambiguous.border-brand-sage-dark/40: hover border -> hover:border-fill-accent (FACE expresses selection as the accent border, not a fourth green).
